jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Adult Customer Service
jokes.joke: I made the mistake of confiding in my spoiled nephew that my job was crushing me. He said, “Have your mom call your boss.” That’s when I realized he thinks adulthood is just childhood with worse customer service.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Confiding in a Toddler
jokes.joke: I made the mistake of venting to my six-year-old niece about my breakup. Told her everything. She just stared at me, then said, "I'm telling Grandma you cried." That's it. That's her whole personality now — a tiny extortionist with a bedtime. I confided in someone who negotiates snack prices for a living. Worst therapist I've ever had, and she bills in gummy bears.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Open Floor Plan
jokes.joke: My girlfriend is incredibly spoiled. She thinks "camping" is when the hotel WiFi drops to two bars. To give her some perspective, I took her to visit my brother on his military base. We were walking through the barracks, staring at the endless rows of miserable, tightly-made cots. She gasped in horror, clutched my arm, and whispered, "Oh my god... an open floor plan?"

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Waiting Room Betrayal
jokes.joke: You guys, I learned the hard way about confiding in the wrong person at the doctor's office. I was there as a patient with this killer headache, so I turn to the guy next to me and spill every detail. Turns out he's there for the exact same thing! When my name gets called, the doctor looks at me like I'm crazy because the other guy already used my symptoms word for word. Now I'm cured of oversharing... but I still have the headache!

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Wrong Confidant
jokes.joke: I once tried to open up about my feelings to a guy I met near a military base. I said, “I’m struggling with vulnerability.” He said, “Copy that,” pulled out a notepad, and asked if my emotions were hostile, approaching, or in need of air support. I’ve never shut down faster in my life.
